description:
Monthly reports from Rotational, the archivist & DJ focussing on electronic dance music from Africa and South-America. Dance to the sound of digitized kuduro CDs, baile funk found on a USB-stick from Rio, or Moroccan techno from dusty cassette tapes.
Besides DJing, Rotational also runs a YouTube channel filled with musical finds from all around the world.
title: Archived w/ Rotational
